sentences.en: Rorschach test-A well-known projective test in which subjects are asked to describe a series of black or colored inkblots.

sentences.en: One well-known projective test is the Rorschach Psycho-diagnostic Test, or inkblot test, first devised by the Swiss psychologist Hermann Rorschach in the 1920s.

sentences.en: Also known as the Rorschach Psychodiagnostic Test.
